# mcp/tests/fixtures/repository_profiles/node/package-lock.json

## Governing Overview

[mcp/tests overview](../../../../overview.md)

## Purpose

Lockfile for the Node repository-profile fixture. Fixes the fixture dependency graph at
`lockfileVersion: 3` with no external packages, proving profile consumers can declare and
verify a repository-owned runtime lock identity for a non-Agents-Remember repository.

## Code Commentary

The lockfile lists only the root package `repository-profile-node-fixture` v1.0.0 with
`requires: true` and an empty `packages` map. It mirrors `package.json` and exists so the
profile's runtime/lock identity contract has real bytes to resolve.

## Invariants And Boundaries

- Fixture data only; never consumed by product code paths outside certification tests.
- Stays byte-for-byte consistent with the adjacent `package.json` manifest.

## Evidence

### Docs References

CCR-R22@v1 requires profiles to declare runtime/toolchain/image/lock identities as
repository-owned configuration selectable by each fixture repository.

Each declared rail carries runtime/toolchain/image/lock identities.

The governing CCR-R22@v1 packet is a task artifact, so this requirement fact is
recorded as prose here (task artifact paths are not repo-relative citations).
